entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-04-02
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Json field with value converter when converter converts nulls isn't converted #37983
    11.0.0

Updated

  • Query: Consider translating String.Equals(String, StringComparison) for selected values of StringComparison #1222
    Backlog
  • Improve GroupBy support #30173
    Backlog
  • GroupBy with a projection of the IGrouping ToArray or other collection results in a inefficient sql query #35991
    Backlog
  • GroupBy on Navigation Property not translating properly #27077
    Backlog
  • Query: Add support for contains with StringComparison like ".Contains(searchString, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase)" #18881
    Backlog
  • Query: Translate DefaultIfEmpty/FirstOrDefault/SingleOrDefault with argument #17783
    Backlog
  • Result of left joining a nullable nominal type should be null (i.e. no instance) and not an instance with all null property values #22517
    11.0.0
  • Consider allowing instantiation with non-parameterless constructor in queries, treating it the same as initializers #34562
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Skip more failing Cosmos tests on the emulator #38040
  • Fix left join with projected nominal type returning "Nullable object must have a value" #38039
  • Fully integrate JSON mapping into the relational model #38038

Merged

  • Fix run value converters that convert nulls for JSON columns #37984
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Cosmos: Modernize JSON serialization - Update pipeline #38024
    community-contribution
